{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Build a premium static Next.js website for an education-focused real estate listing platform called “CampusNest Properties”. It should feel like a professional product showcase / listing website for schools, universities, training institutes, and student housing providers looking for academic spaces. IMPORTANT: this is a fully static front-end only website, no backend, no database, no login, no booking engine, no real map API, no external real estate API. Use mock/sample property data inside the project.

Overall Style: Clean, modern, trustworthy, professional, education + real estate blend. Use a light background with deep navy, academic blue, soft gold accents, white cards, subtle shadows, rounded corners, and polished spacing. The website should look like a high-end real estate marketplace for the education sector.

Tech Requirements: Use Next.js with React components. Static rendering only. Use reusable components and sample JSON/static arrays for listings. Make it responsive for desktop, tablet, and mobile. Add tasteful cursor effects: custom cursor dot/ring, hover magnetic effect on CTA buttons, listing cards slightly following cursor/glow on hover, but keep it professional and not gimmicky.

Pages / Sections:

1. Header / Navigation
- Logo: CampusNest Properties
- Nav links: Home, Listings, For Institutions, Neighborhoods, Insights, Contact
- CTA button: “View Featured Spaces”
- Sticky header with blur background on scroll

2. Hero Section
Headline: “Find Education-Ready Spaces Built for Learning”
Subtitle: “Explore curated campuses, student residences, tutoring centers, training facilities, and academic office spaces — all presented with clear details and professional guidance.”
Hero layout: left text + CTAs, right side premium property preview card stack
CTA buttons: “Browse Listings” and “Download Sample Brochure”
Include trust stats: 120+ sample listings, 35 campus zones, 18 institution types, 4.9 advisor rating
Use elegant background shapes/grid pattern, not too busy.

3. Search / Filter Showcase Bar
Static UI only, no real search required but it should look functional.
Fields: Property Type, City / Campus Zone, Capacity, Budget Range
Button: “Explore Matches”
Add note: “Static demo filters for presentation only.”

4. Featured Education Real Estate Listings
Create 8 mock listing cards with realistic educational property examples:
- Modern Student Residence near North Campus
- Private Tutoring Center in Academic District
- Training Institute Floor with Smart Classrooms
- Small University Annex Building
- Language School Studio Campus
- Research Office Suite near Innovation Park
- Co-Learning Hub for EdTech Teams
- Boarding School Expansion Plot
Each card should include image placeholder/gradient, tag, location, price/rent estimate, capacity, square footage, key features, and CTA “View Details”.
Cards should have premium hover interaction and cursor glow effect.

5. Featured Listing Detail Showcase
A large split section for one highlighted property:
Title: “Northbridge Learning Residence”
Include gallery-style static thumbnails, property specs, bullet features, campus distance, amenities, zoning suitability, and advisor note.
Use beautiful comparison chips like “Student Housing”, “5 min to campus”, “180 beds”, “Study lounges”.
CTA: “Request Static Info Pack” but do not build a form backend.

6. Property Categories Section
Cards for:
- Student Housing
- Training Centers
- School Buildings
- Tutoring Studios
- Campus Retail Spaces
- Research & Admin Offices
Each category should have icon-style visuals and short descriptions.

7. Why CampusNest Section
Professional selling points:
- Education-specific property criteria
- Capacity and compliance-focused presentation
- Neighborhood and transit context
- Investor/institution friendly summaries
- Static brochures and comparison-ready layouts
Design with alternating cards, icons, and subtle academic branding.

8. Neighborhood / Campus Zone Showcase
Static section highlighting 4 sample zones:
- North Campus Corridor
- Downtown Academic Quarter
- Innovation Park
- Riverside Student Village
Each should have average sample rent, best for, transit score, nearby institutions, and a mini static map-style graphic made with CSS only, no real maps.

9. Comparison Table
Create a clean comparison table comparing 4 property types across: ideal users, typical capacity, lease style, amenities, best location, budget level. Must be responsive.

10. Process Section
Steps:
1. Define academic space needs
2. Compare education-ready listings
3. Review static info pack
4. Schedule advisor walkthrough concept
5. Shortlist final spaces
Make this look like a professional timeline.

11. Testimonials
3 mock testimonials from fictional roles like university facilities director, tutoring franchise owner, education investor. Include names but make them clearly sample/demo.

12. Insights / Editorial Cards
Static article cards:
- “How to Evaluate a Student Housing Location”
- “What Makes a Property Education-Ready?”
- “Checklist for Training Center Layouts”
No blog backend, just cards.

13. Contact / Lead Section
Static contact-style CTA with fields visually shown only or a non-functional front-end form. Text: “Tell us what kind of learning space you need.” Include name, institution, property type, message fields, but no submission backend. Button can show “Send Inquiry Demo”. Add small disclaimer: “Static prototype — no information is submitted.”

14. Footer
Columns: Company, Property Types, Resources, Contact
Include fake address and social links as simple icons/text.

Design Details:
- Use professional typography, strong hierarchy, lots of whitespace.
- Use CSS animations: fade-up on sections, soft hover lift, smooth cursor ring, magnetic button hover, animated gradient line under headings.
- No external images required; use elegant CSS gradients/placeholders or local placeholder blocks. If using images, use generic static placeholders only.
- Make the website feel complete and production-polished even though all data is mock/static.
- Ensure accessibility basics: semantic HTML, alt text, visible focus states, good contrast.
- The final result should be a complex but static Next.js product showcase website for education-sector real estate listings.",

 }

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
